info.name: Instacompay Gateway API (v1)
info.description:
**Import → fill in 3 variables → Send.** No signing, no scripts, no setup.

1. Open the collection's **Variables** tab
2. Paste your `apiKey`, `apiSecret` and `accountId` (Merchant Portal → API Documentation → regenerate a SANDBOX key to reveal them)
3. Hit **Send** on any request

Start with a sandbox key (`ic_sand_…`) — it simulates and settles instantly, so no real money moves and no float is used.

---

Instacompay Gateway — collections & disbursements over Zambian mobile money (ZMW).

## Set up (30 seconds)
Open the collection's **Variables** tab and paste:
- `apiKey`    — e.g. ic_sand_… (Merchant Portal → API Documentation)
- `apiSecret` — shown once when you generate/regenerate a key
- `accountId` — your account id

Then press **Send**. That's it — no signing, no scripts.

## Auth
Every request carries two headers:

    X-Api-Key: {{apiKey}}
    X-Api-Secret: {{apiSecret}}

(You can send `Authorization: Bearer <secret>` instead of `X-Api-Secret` if you prefer.)

HMAC request signing is also supported for higher-security integrations — see the Public API guide at https://merchants.instacompayzm.com/partners.

## Rails
Only rails that are live in production are accepted — currently **AIRTEL**. Sandbox rejects anything production would reject, so if it works here it works when you go live.

## Refunds
There is no reverse/void call. To refund a customer send a **disbursement** for what they actually paid (`amount + charge` if they covered the fee) — see the "Refund a customer" request.

## Money
All amounts are **integer ngwee, as strings**: K1.50 = "150", K50.00 = "5000". Never decimals.

## Sandbox
Start with a sandbox key (`ic_sand_…`). Sandbox simulates and settles instantly — no real money, no float used — so you can test the full PROCESSING → SUCCESS lifecycle.

`Idempotency-Key` is set automatically to a fresh GUID on every write; reuse the same value to safely retry a request.

request.description:
Charge a customer's mobile-money wallet. amount is ngwee ("5000" = K50.00). processor: currently AIRTEL (MTN is not yet enabled in production — sending it returns a clear 400).

Production prompts the customer's phone and returns PROCESSING — poll the status endpoint until SUCCESS. Sandbox settles instantly.
Send money to a customer's wallet. msisdn is required (12-digit, e.g. 260970000001). Dispatches to the rail immediately.

There is no reverse/void call — a refund is a real transfer back to the customer.

**Amount:** refund what the customer actually PAID. If they covered the fee that is `amount + charge` (K1.00 + K0.03 = "103"), not the `net_amount` you received.

**Reconciliation:** put the original order in `collectionReference` so the refund ties back to it.

It returns its own transaction id — poll **Get transaction status** to confirm it landed.

Status of any transaction — collection or disbursement. txnId is auto-filled from the last create call. Re-enquires the rail on read.

PROCESSING → SUCCESS | FAILED.
Float / balance enquiry for your account. Balance is ngwee.
Settlements for the account behind the api key.
